target: scaffold.sh install — refuses to clobber an adopted region-managed file
cmd:
source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/scaffold.sh"; source "$FIXTURES/scaffold-fixture.sh"; export SCAFFOLD_STAMP_PATH=scripts/.agentic-scaffold.json; scaffold_fake_plugin fake 0.11.0; mkdir -p fake/templates/workflows .claude/workflows scripts/lib; cp "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/workflow.sh" scripts/lib/workflow.sh; printf '%s
' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=p owner=plugin' 'const P = "upstream"' '// @agentic-loop:end region=p' > fake/templates/workflows/factory.js; printf '%s
' 'const MINE = 1' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=p owner=plugin' 'const P = "upstream"' '// @agentic-loop:end region=p' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=mine owner=project' 'const PORT = 8787' '// @agentic-loop:end region=mine' > .claude/workflows/factory.js; ADOPTED=$(scaffold_install fake software-unattended | awk -F'	' '$1 ~ /factory.js/ {print $2}'); MINE=$(grep -c 'PORT = 8787' .claude/workflows/factory.js); printf '%s
' 'const OLD = 1' > .claude/workflows/factory.js; UNADOPTED=$(scaffold_install fake software-unattended | awk -F'	' '$1 ~ /factory.js/ {print $2}'); HASMARKERS=$(grep -c '@agentic-loop:begin' .claude/workflows/factory.js); jq -n --arg a "$ADOPTED" --arg u "$UNADOPTED" --argjson m "$MINE" --argjson h "$HASMARKERS" '{adopted_action: $a, unadopted_action: $u, project_region_kept: $m, markers_after: $h}'
_note: regression test for a real incident (2026-07-27): a hand-rolled cp loop over the manifest overwrote a project's region-managed workflow wholesale, destroying its project-owned sequencing and machine-specific prompt addenda. The ownership rule was documentation, not a gate. Guards both directions — an ADOPTED file (has markers) is refused so merge-regions handles it; an UNADOPTED one (no markers) is still copied, which is how it receives markers in the first place.
